title: Consent mapping (People's Court Partner API v2)
description: Output contract for the consent artifact the adapter derives from an ADAL/1 package's EVP/1 consent labels. Mirrors the documented consent surface (/api/v2/authorizations/consents). Modeled assent is carried as an EVP/1 derived tri-state string (FULL|PARTIAL|MISSING|UNKNOWN) and is never converted into an assertion of bilateral real-world consent. Artifact ID assignment is the platform's, after evidence submission.
